messages:
mira: heads-up: planning cross-service rollout tonight 23:00 UTC. services: api:v2026-04-01.1, runtime:2.3.1, router:0.9.7, console:1.12.3. need final pin + rollback agreement.

sam: lock runtime to 2.3.1 (hosted + dedicated). fallback runtime:2.2.8 if kv-thrash.

jordan: console no schema changes. router header-split toggle will be controlled by canary policy. sequence: api -> runtime -> router -> console.

mira: proposed canary: 5% for 12m, then 30% for 8m, then 100%. stagger 45s between services.

rita: auto-rollback triggers: API 5xx >0.5% sustained over 5m; p50 latency +75ms for 10m; runtime OOMs or kv-evict >3x baseline or >10 uncaught exceptions/min. Manual abort: /deploy abort <run-id>.

sam: add visual regression grep for `render_error` on console, and alert devex for function/tooling failures. kernel-quant only in canary; watch tokenization diffs and kv miss rate.

mira: locking pins: runtime:2.3.1 (fallback 2.2.8), console:1.12.3, router:0.9.7, api:v2026-04-01.1.

jordan: I'll inject a quick failover rule: if new console error_rate >1% for 3m -> route 0% to new console.

mira: planned deploy command:
```
/deploy orchestrate --services api,runtime,router,console --canary 5 --canary-duration 12m --staged 30,100 --stagger 45s --pin runtime:2.3.1 --fallback runtime:2.2.8 --tag v2026-04-01.1
```

deploy-bot: scheduled orchestrated deploy (run-id: 20260401-05) by mira at 2026-04-01T23:00:00Z. Canary plan set; auto-rollback thresholds applied.

mira: starting run in ~20m. speak now if you want to hold.

jordan: ready, monitoring hooks in place.

rita: ops abort snippet for runbook:
```
/deploy abort 20260401-05 --reason "auto-threshold"
/deploy promote fallback --services runtime --version 2.2.8
```

sam: I'll add a short note to release_notes about kernel-quant toggle and console bundle update.

mira: will update release_notes.md after completion with metrics and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
